title: Agent login, warm reset/block and logout
steps: Use Suresh; restart; admin reset/block during assigned work.
expected: Correct identity/queues; invalid sessions exit; work remains available to admin.

title: Assignment, retail/recovery filters and old active work
steps: Assign/reassign; filter active sections; load older history.
expected: Only owned work visible; old active runs never disappear behind bounded history.

title: Checklist, pickup and wrong-agent rejection
steps: Try no/partial/full checklist, duplicate taps and stale assignment.
expected: Only full owned pickup commits; all roles and notices reflect one state change.

title: COD/UPI completion and exact counts
steps: Deliver retail order via each payment mode; record returned cans; retry completion.
expected: One retail sale/delivery, accurate cash/QR attribution, fixed original payee, exact can debt and no duplicate metric delta.

title: Partial recovery across days and final collection
steps: Collect 0, partial, revisit later and complete remaining cans.
expected: Zero cannot finish; same remaining run open; visit history cumulative; retail revenue/order/earnings not inflated.

title: Online/offline/deactivation invariants
steps: Try offline/removal during delivery and waiting recovery, then after all work is settled.
expected: No orphan/hidden assignment; archived identity preserves completed ownership; restored test availability.

title: Collections versus actual delivery fees earned
steps: Compare before/after each stage, daily/weekly/monthly dates, cash collected and agreed agentFee.
expected: Earned delivery fees must be identified separately from COD cash, with recovery/cancelled work excluded and payout state not invented. This is currently a product/UI gap.
knownGap: The current agent sheet does not render a separate earned-delivery-fee or payout tracker. Cash collections cannot satisfy this check.

title: All agent controls, calls/maps, notices and permissions
steps: Exercise each Agent control plus external actions, errors and push denial on device.
expected: Expected route/state and affected-role effects; no spontaneous call/message; durable in-app notice regardless of push availability.
